source_title: 'Sidelined 3: End Game,' 'The Hunger Games' and More Movies You Can Stream for Free in November 2026 - CNET
source_excerpt:
Jennifer Lawrence stars in The Hunger Games.
If you’ve grown tired of relentless price hikes from your favorite streaming platforms , it’s nice to know that free TV streaming services such as Tubi, Kanopy, Plex and Pluto TV can be counted on for all kinds of great shows and movies. New films and TV shows arrive on these platforms every month, making them fantastic options if you don’t want to pay for another service.
This month marks the arrival of tons of great movies. On Plex, you can watch critically acclaimed hits like Sofia Coppola’s Priscilla and the Oscar-winning Moonlight and character-driven biopics like The Iron Lady, starring Meryl Streep as Margaret Thatcher, or Vice, starring Christian Bale as former Vice President Dick Cheney.
In what has become an annual Tubi Thanksgiving tradition, a new film in the Sidelined series will be dropping this November. You can log in for Sidelined 3: End Game, starring Noah Beck and Siena Agudong, when it premieres on Nov. 26.
Also arriving on Tubi in November are Coraline, The Boxtrolls and Kubo and the Two Strings, three great stop-motion animation films produced by Laika, the studio responsible for the recent theatrical hit Wildwood. You’ll also find the first five films in the Hunger Games series — just in time for the release of the sixth installment, Sunrise on the Reaping.
Also, a lot of great A24 films are dropping this month across these free platforms, including Minari, Aftersun, 20th Century Women and more.
The popular sports rom-com Sidelined: The QB and Me debuted on Tubi back in 2024. It proved to be such a hit that two sequels have followed: Sidelined 2: Intercepted in 2025, and now Sidelined 3: End Game, which will arrive on Tubi on Nov. 26. The film reunites Noah Beck and Siena Agudong as quarterback Drayton Lahey and dancer Dallas Bryan and continues the story of their young romance. (We’ll know if they get their happy ending because Tubi confirmed that this will be the final film in the series.)
